intro: Georgia's economy relies on tourism, wine, trade routes and money sent home from abroad.

chapters.title: Crossroads
text: Pipelines and railways carry oil, gas and goods from the Caspian to Turkey and the Black Sea through Georgia.

chapters.title: Wine and tourism
text: Georgian wine, mineral water from Borjomi and tourism to mountains and beaches are big earners.

keyTerms.meaning: A long pipe that carries oil or gas.

cardGroups.title: Made in Georgia
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Georgia makes and sells to the world.
